en: \[VSCode] Fixed one cause of sessions failing to start with "Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms": time a SessionStart command hook spends running no longer counts toward the limit, up to 10 minutes in total
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了 session 以“Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms”启动失败的一个原因：SessionStart 命令 hook 的运行时间不再计入该限制，总计最多 10 分钟
